items.kind: tooling (release process) — BUILT on next @60c2c6e5 and release/0.41 @793a91f6, 2026-09-27
items.status: OPEN — filed 2026-09-27 with the fix in; close at the v0.41.1 sweep; releases.md §7.3 owes a sentence
items.title: a §7.3 patch branch had NO CI: `ci.yml` ran on pushes to `next`/`main` and on pull requests only, and a patch's release commit (the `## Unreleased` retitle + the manifest bump) CONFLICTS with `next` by construction, so a pull request from `release/0.MINOR` gets no run — `cut-release.sh`'s L17 gate could never see the tag commit green; fixed: `ci.yml` runs on `release/**` pushes
items.discussion: v0.41.1's cut (the integrator, 2026-09-27): two close/reopen kicks and a marker cherry-pick got ONE run at the pre-release head; the release commit itself could not get one; releases.md §7.3 says 'the pipeline needs no change at all' about release.yml and is silent on ci.yml, which L17 later made the gate
items.body: **Built.** `on.push.branches: [next, main, "release/**"]` with the reason in the workflow (793a91f6 on the patch branch, cherry-picked to next as 60c2c6e5). The pins `release_gate.rs` / `ci_local_script.rs` are indifferent to the trigger and stay green. **Owed:** releases.md §7.3 step 3 gains: 'push the branch — `ci.yml` runs on `release/**`, and the cut reads that run — before `cut-release.sh`; a pull request is not a substitute'. And the marker lesson beside it: on a cherry-picked branch the sweep's derived commit is the `next`-side original, so the two entries carry `<!-- commit: -->` markers (0cc8a25c), and `next` must carry the same markers or the branch conflicts there too.
